goal: Frontend, backend, database, and related packs install as versioned coverage
scenarios: the catalog lists frontend, backend, database, and related versioned skill packs
a project scan recommends skill packs from the workspace
a WorkItem can declare required skill packs
installing a pack makes its versioned coverage available to the project
the agent runtime loads only the relevant installed pack skills for the selected task
a missing required pack blocks the agent run
constraints: do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
nonGoals: adding technology packs to the coding environment baseline
